summary_check.corrected_summary: Rule 46 prescribes tax-invoice particulars, including serial number, supplier and recipient details, classification, value, tax and place of supply, subject to rule 54 and special recipient rules. It adds conditional IRN/QR and exemption-declaration requirements, export/SEZ endorsements, limited daily consolidated invoicing and an electronic-invoice signature exception.

metadata_check.issues: The daily consolidated-invoice exception expressly excludes multiplex cinema admission suppliers; metadata wrongly says exhibition-service suppliers may use it.
